evals.prompt: Disk writes on instance app-server-01 became very slow in the last 15 minutes. Is the disk the cause? Why, and what should I do? Look into it here in chat, don't open an investigation.
evals.expected_output: Answers Yes. Identifies the gp3 volume flat at its provisioned IOPS with VolumeIOPSExceededCheck at 1, and the instance well under its EBS IOPS limit. Says CloudWatch latency looks low but the application waits longer. Says the observed IOPS is a minimum and recommends raising the provisioned IOPS above it, checking the instance limit first. No support case and no offer to make the change.
assertions: The response identifies the gp3 volume at its provisioned IOPS limit
The response checks the instance EBS IOPS limit and says it is not reached
The response says the application waits longer than CloudWatch latency shows
The response says real demand may be higher than the observed IOPS and recommends raising provisioned IOPS above it
The response does not offer to modify the volume on the user's behalf (advising the user how to change it is fine)
